name: agentic_fund_manager
description: Actively manage the Robinhood Agentic account toward modernized 60/40. Risk is bounded by capital deposited into the agentic account only. Not day-trading — low-frequency active management. Process is size-invariant: same research/rotate standards at $10 or $10k.

cadence.notes: Target one automated review per trading day (mid-session). That is a schedule floor for attention, NOT a trade cap — a single review may place zero or many orders if quorum agrees. Extra reviews OK after large deposits or live:false→true. Avoid open/close noise; no day-trading mandate. Every deploy/review that deploys capital MUST run the uniform research_rotate process (not top-up-held-only).

process.size_invariant_notes: Do not skip thematic research or default to topping existing names merely because NAV is small. Strategy, themes, and decision quality are the same at $10 or $10k; only order notionals scale.

research_rotate.forbid_held_only_notes: Never default to 'add only to existing positions' without an explicit research/rotate case that other allowlist/theme names were considered and rejected with reasons.

owner_preferences.digital_credit_emphasis: Within the ~40% BTC & digital credit complex, keep a small standing bias toward STRC and/or SATA (preferred digital-credit core). They are BTC-fundamentally based, high-yield, frequent-dividend expressions — not cash. Owner 2026-08-04: those yields are roughly ~2× typical USDC/USDG high-yield cash, so when residual dollars would otherwise sit in cash-like yield, prefer a real STRC/SATA seat over pure cash proxies. Do not make the entire 40% credit-only; still diversify miners/infra and allow MSTR/BITA/ASST. Skip STRC/SATA only with a strong, logged Risk/Critic rebuttal (liquidity, structure, ticket-size, or thesis).
owner_preferences.yield_vs_cash: STRC/SATA yield > USDC/USDG cash yields (~2× owner estimate) → digital credit is the preferred idle-capital expression inside the agentic BTC complex when free capital is being deployed into the 40% sleeve; cash is unallocated, not a competing long-term sleeve.
owner_preferences.miner_diversification: Multiple miners (MARA, IREN, CLSK, RIOT, WULF, …) is desired diversification within the miner sleeve. Reject 'miner overlap' as a default no. Only concentrate or skip miners when credit/MSTR underweight, liquidity fails, or true single-name/book concentration risk.
owner_preferences.notes: 2026-07-27 elevated STRC/SATA; 2026-08-04 reframes as small bias within 40% + yield-vs-cash rationale (USDC/USDG). Apply on next review/deploy; strong team rebuttal must be logged if overriding.

owner_feedback.notes: Owner may chime in after a pass with adjustments. Do not block for feedback. Apply post-pass feedback on the next review unless owner sets live:false.

quorum.notes: Risk + Thesis must OK; Critic may force hold or size-down. Scout is advisory.

scout.job: Snapshot agentic book, quotes, sleeve weights, cash to deploy; load allowlist + watchlist + latest research; list held vs unheld theme coverage

thesis.job: Research/rotate: map themes to best capital allocation now across held + unheld allowlist (not held-only). Propose buys/holds with theme fit (new cash only; NO sells, trims or shorts). May propose watchlist adds.

risk.job: Capital bounds, concentration, liquidity, whether to trade; size guidance. Size may be small at low NAV but process is not simplified.

critic.job: Challenge held-only inertia, weak theme fit, missing alternatives; may block or demand different names/size

executor.job: Only role that places/cancels via Robinhood MCP; must log full rationale including alternatives considered

rationale.purpose: Surface fleet debate so the owner can review after each pass and give optional feedback. Do not wait for feedback mid-pass.

automation.notes: Daily mid-session review + BP poll every ~15m (market hours). Any agentic cash>0 or BP>0 triggers full research/rotate team (no %NAV floor). RH snapshot ~3h via rh_refresh. launchd: com.personalworkspace.fund-manager-bp-poll + rh-refresh. Pi: fund-manager-bp-poll.timer. | 2026-10-24: bp-poll no longer buys on any cash > $0; it starts ONE buy run only when settled cash >= $5 (python3 -m treasury.fund_manager_broker --should-buy), at most once per ET day, shared with the daily run.

account.notes: Weightings and trades use agentic book only. Primary margin is out of scope for the fund manager.

approval.notes: No per-trade pop-up and no required owner feedback. Dashboard shows debate for optional oversight. Kill switch: withdraw agentic capital or set live:false.

limits.notes: No max notional — agent discretion. Optional min avoids dust orders.

targets.notes: Modernized 60/40: ~40% BTC & digital credit complex, ~60% stocks/growth. Cash counts as unallocated until deployed. Within the 40% complex, small bias toward STRC/SATA (BTC-fundamental high-yield / frequent dividends; yield edge vs USDC/USDG cash) — not MSTR-only by habit, not 40% all-credit.

symbol_targets.notes: Chairman 2026-09-22: Agentic STOCKS sleeve = 50% SPCX / 50% TSLA by MV. consider_share.json pins TSLA50/SPCX50 are authoritative. No other equity names in stocks sleeve or Monday theme-gap. Crypto/cash unchanged unless Chairman says otherwise. Ongoing stocks capital deploys 50/50 SPCX+TSLA only.

digital_credit.notes: Owner 2026-08-04: small bias inside the 40% stack toward STRC/SATA — BTC-fundamental high-yield / frequent-dividend credit, not cash. Yield edge vs USDC/USDG (~2× owner estimate) is the economic case for preferring a real STRC/SATA seat over cash-like residual. Do not reject STRC/SATA solely as 'illiquid for tiny tickets' or 'MSTR+BITA already cover credit' without a strong liquidity/risk rebuttal. Bias is small (presence + preferential residual), not 40% all-credit. Owner 2026-09-29 / Nakatoshi 2026-10-10: STRK moved to preferred_core with new_money_weights STRC 25 / SATA 25 / STRK 15 / 35 floating (buy-only; see sleeve new_money_weights). Not Jack Mallers Strike; not Starknet STRK. | Chris 2026-10-28 (5:53 PM ET, relayed by Grok): SATS (Strive 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred, Nasdaq GM) is a full member of the sleeve. The sleeve is a spectrum, and same-issuer concentration with SATA/ASST is not a reason to exclude or trim. Ruled new-money weight: SATS 10, taken from floating (see new_money_weights.ruled_2026_10_28).

miners_infra.notes: Owner 2026-07-27: multi-miner diversification is intentional. Do NOT reject RIOT/CLSK/WULF/etc. merely for 'miner overlap' or 'already have MARA+IREN'. Diversify mining beta across names; only block on true concentration (e.g. miners crowding out digital credit / MSTR / whole-book limits), liquidity, or thesis failure.

hard_money_metals.notes: Owner 2026-09-07: gold as sound-money sleeve, lower priority than Bitcoin positions. Vehicle TBD (gold ETF and/or gold miners) — research-only until owner calls a buy. No auto-buy. No Bias consider-share stamp until buy called. Not RH Gold membership. Not a substitute for BTC / digital credit / miners.

btc_digital_credit.notes: BTC complex = digital credit + miners/infra + optional sound-money metals. New-money weights (buy-only): STRC 25 / SATA 25 / STRK 15 / 35 floating (BTC/MSTR/ASST/BITA + miners MARA, RIOT, CLSK, WULF, IREN). Multi-miner diversification intentional. Gold sound-money (2026-09-07): below BTC priority; vehicle TBD; research-only until buy call.

new_money_weights.notes: Chris 2026-09-29 policy (Nakatoshi confirmed 2026-10-10): NEW cash into btc_digital_credit splits STRC 25 / SATA 25 / STRK 15 / 35 floating. Floating universe = BTC, MSTR, ASST, BITA + miners (MARA, RIOT, CLSK, WULF, IREN). Buy-only — never sell/trim to chase these weights (Chris 2026-09-22 order, #1093 no-sell guard). Executor wiring lands with #1093. | Nakatoshi 2026-10-24: IBIT replaces BTC in the floating universe as the native-BTC stand-in (the account cannot hold spot BTC); legs < $1 fold into IBIT. MSTR low preference through 2026-11-30 (execution.broker_adapter.low_preference) applies only if honor_ai_floating is turned on. 2026-10-26: the floating 35% always goes to fold_into (IBIT). honor_ai_floating is false, so the planner ignores AI-proposed floating names. Hard-enforced by treasury/fund_manager_broker.plan_intents. | 2026-10-28: Chris ruled SATS 10 / floating 25 (STRC/SATA/STRK unchanged). Recorded in ruled_2026_10_28; not executable until the planner reads SATS as a fixed leg (see that block). | 2026-10-28 (Forge): live keys now STRC 25 / SATA 25 / STRK 15 / SATS 10 / floating 25. The planner reads every uppercase ticker key with a numeric weight here as a fixed leg (each must be on symbol_allowlist; fixed + floating must sum to 1). SATS is bought only when a live quote is <= sats_guards.limit_price_max_usd; otherwise its leg folds into IBIT.

ruled_2026_10_28.status: live_in_keys_2026_10_28 (executes once the planner change is deployed to the Pi)
ruled_2026_10_28.ruled_by: Chris 2026-10-28 5:53 PM ET (relayed by Grok); recorded by Nakatoshi
ruled_2026_10_28.why_not_live: treasury/fund_manager_broker.load_adapter_config hard-codes the fixed legs to STRC/SATA/STRK and rejects the config unless STRC+SATA+STRK+floating == 1. Writing SATS 0.10 / floating 0.25 into the live keys would make that sum 0.90. The adapter would then refuse to load (fail closed), which stops ALL buy runs, while SATS still got nothing. So the live keys above stay STRC 25 / SATA 25 / STRK 15 / floating 35 until the executor reads SATS.
ruled_2026_10_28.activation: Forge (code change, not done here): make the fixed legs data-driven (every non-floating numeric key in new_money_weights, with each symbol required to be on symbol_allowlist), add SATS tests, add SATS to execution.broker_adapter.symbol_allowlist (left off for now because test_repo_config_allowlist_and_ibit_floating pins that list, and it would do nothing before the planner change), then copy this block into the live keys (SATS 0.10, floating 0.25). Guards in sleeves.btc_digital_credit.sats_guards must ship with or before that change.
ruled_2026_10_28.first_deposit: The first funded Agentic deposit whose buy run happens after the executor change has landed on the Pi. Not 11/15 unless the change lands before that run.

sats_guards.limit_price_note: ENFORCED by treasury/fund_manager_broker._plan (2026-10-28): before each run the planner reads a live SATS quote (read-only get_quotes) and skips the SATS leg, folding it into IBIT, when the quote is above limit_price_max_usd or unavailable. Earlier note: DOCUMENTED ONLY. The broker adapter supports market dollar orders only (load_adapter_config rejects any order_type other than market). A $95 cap needs a quote check in the planner: skip the SATS leg (or fold it into IBIT) when the live ask is above $95.
sats_guards.no_margin_enforced: partly. Every run is capped at settled cash (min(settled cash, max_run, daily cap left)), and submit re-checks live settled cash and buying power, so the adapter never buys on margin. 'No margin borrowing against SATS' (and not counting SATS toward the HY LTV buffer) is a manual or policy rule. No code checks it.
stop_buy_triggers: Any SATS regular dividend skipped, deferred or not declared by its business-day payment date
Strive issues any new security that ranks senior to SATS (new senior preferred, notes or other debt)
sats_guards.stop_buy_enforced: Trigger DETECTION is documented only (Naka checks in the daily fund brief). The STOP ACTION is enforced once applied: adding SATS to guardrails.blocked_symbols blocks it in both the order gate and the planner. Buy-only, so a trigger never means a sell.

Watchlist AI/growth (GOOGL, AAPL, NVDA, PLTR, AMZN) + EVGO (low-priority charging) + space alternative RKLB via investment/watchlist.json — owner-add triggers auto deep-dive → ready for consider set each deploy; never auto-buy. GOOGL/NVDA currently held (not promoted to core). SPCX is the space core; RKLB is Neutron optionality, not a substitute. CCJ is held opportunistic nuclear (energy_opportunistic sleeve list, stocks_growth when owned).

energy_opportunistic.notes: No core mandate. BE REMOVED 2026-09-08 (owner exit 2026-09-03): sold; 50/50 TSLA+SPCX; OFF Agentic DCA / Monday theme-gap / consider set — do not reseat. CCJ = nuclear fuel + 49% Westinghouse. BWXT = Navy nuclear floor + commercial components. Owner-add CCJ/BWXT 2026-08-31 (Chronometer/Smith option A). Deep-dive + ready each deploy; never auto-buy; not a basket. EXE not named — pass. Incident 2026-09-08: morning $25 deploy bought $5 BE because watchlist still ready — nest SoT corrected.

watchlist.on_review: Scout/Thesis MUST include every status=ready watchlist name in the consider set each allocation assessment (alongside held + unheld core). Reject with reasons if not sized. Prefer core allowlist for routine rebalance when relative value favors it; strong theme bias. Owner-added names must not stall on monitor without a dive. Agents may PROPOSE new names (start as monitor → auto-queue dive → ready). Never auto-buy.
watchlist.notes: Owner 2026-08-04: watchlist = active allocation interest. Auto deep-dive on add; default status ready after dive (pass only if explicit); periodic refresh. Discovery/proposal ≠ order authority.

private_watchlist.on_owner_add: Immediately queue private deep-dive (same process as public position-deep-dive, pre-IPO adapted) → write investment/research/private/{ID}_deep_dive.md; optional short brief. Do NOT queue public position-deep-dive until ticker exists. Do not leave owner names without homework.
private_watchlist.on_listing_or_ipo: Promote to investment/watchlist.json (owner or agent proposal) with status monitor → immediate position-deep-dive → ready only after dive. Never auto-buy on listing day.
private_watchlist.on_review: Scout may surface IPO/list catalysts for private names as context only. Private names MUST NOT enter the public deploy consider set or receive orders. Pre-IPO secondaries out of scope. Each private name should have a current deep-dive (< deep_dive_refresh_days) just as public ready names do.
private_watchlist.notes: Owner 2026-08-06: private lane (Anduril #1, Saronic #2, Boom #3) + same deep research process as public watchlist. Capital discipline unchanged.
private_watchlist.deep_dive_workflow: position-deep-dive (emulate private: id=NAME, no public market claims)

when_to_run.position_deep_dive: IMMEDIATELY on owner watchlist add; on agent-proposed add after merge; when last_deep_dive older than deep_dive_refresh_days (default 90); before first buy if stale; on material news/earnings/drawdown; on owner request
when_to_run.portfolio_research: On need_llm reviews, capital step-changes, periodic thematic scan, or when watchlist empty/stale; may propose new candidates
when_to_run.private_position_deep_dive: IMMEDIATELY on owner private-watchlist add; when last_deep_dive older than deep_dive_refresh_days (90); on material funding/IPO/news; on owner request. Never grants deploy authority.

research.notes: Native Grok .rhai workflows under .grok/workflows/. position-deep-dive follows Grok Build /deep-research shape: Plan → parallel claim research → adversarial Verify (fail-closed) → Report (Partial if drops) plus fund Critic/verdict. If host lacks workflow tool, emulate the same phases inline and still write research files. After a successful dive, set watchlist status to ready (unless explicit pass). Never place trades from research alone.

allowlist.notes: strict=false: core preferred for routine rebalance; ready watchlist names MUST be in the consider set every deploy (owner 2026-08-04). Strong theme bias. Within BTC complex, small bias to STRC/SATA (yield > cash; do not underweight by habit); multi-miner holds are OK.

guardrails.notes: v1: agentic funding is the risk budget. FCC card/loan stress does not block agentic trades (separate capital). | 2026-09-08: BE in blocked_symbols — owner exit 2026-09-03; never auto-buy / never Monday theme-gap.

market_calendar.source: NYSE Holidays & Trading Hours, https://www.nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (checked 2026-10-24; matches Nakatoshi's list). Fail closed outside these years.

MSTR.notes: Nakatoshi 2026-10-24: keep MSTR on the floating list but prefer other floating names through this date (prompt-level; logged when chosen).

broker_adapter.notes: Nakatoshi 2026-10-24 (Grok-approved). Buy-only adapter + deterministic run planner behind the #1093 gate. Agentic ~60% stocks (TSLA/SPCX 50/50) / 40% BTC + digital credit; hold, never sell (any sell is a manual action Chris takes himself). New cash fills BTC + digital credit first until 40% of invested value; no TSLA/SPCX buy while under 40%. BTC sleeve per run: STRC 25 / SATA 25 / STRK 15 (tolerance max($1, 5% of run)); the floating 35% is always IBIT (honor_ai_floating false — AI-proposed floating names such as MSTR or miners are ignored); legs < $1 fold into IBIT. Run cap min(settled cash, $160, daily cap left); skip under $5 investable. Market dollar DAY orders, regular hours, not before 10:00 ET, no queuing. One buy run per ET day shared by daily + bp-poll (same-day fills placed outside the adapter count). Placed orders post a decision entry to #701. client empty until prism sets FM_BROKER_CLIENT=grok_mcp.

execution.notes: Dollar/fractional market only in regular_hours (queue if after hours). Outside regular hours use extended limit only when fractional allowed.
